tree_canopy_growth.name: Tree canopy growth model
tree_canopy_growth.grain: individual tree at an explicit future horizon
tree_canopy_growth.validation: Group spatial hold-out by precinct and temporal hold-out by observation year; report MAE and empirical interval coverage by species.
tree_canopy_growth.limitations: City of Melbourne training coverage is not representative of all residential Melbourne. Do not extrapolate unsupported species or horizons.

melbourne_canopy_change.name: Melbourne canopy change model
melbourne_canopy_change.grain: consistently aligned City of Melbourne analysis cell
melbourne_canopy_change.validation: Spatial block cross-validation with complete suburbs or LGAs held out; report MAE and interval coverage, including growth-area error slices.
melbourne_canopy_change.limitations: The initial five-year target covers the City of Melbourne municipality, not all Melbourne. Different 2016 and 2021 mapping methods may create non-biological differences. The target records net canopy change, not the causal effect of a particular planting action.

cooling_association.name: Vegetation and surface-cooling association model
cooling_association.grain: spatial cell and Landsat acquisition time

datasets.role: optional observation cross-check subject to feed-specific licence

cooling_association.validation: Hold out complete spatial blocks and acquisition dates; compare against a weather-only baseline and report MAE, bias and interval coverage.
cooling_association.limitations: This is an association model for Landsat land-surface temperature, not causal intervention cooling and not resident-level air temperature.

garden_cooling.name: Irrigated garden cooling model

datasets.role: paired irrigated and unirrigated experimental observations

garden_cooling.validation: Train on the 2021 experiment and hold out the 2022 experiment; report treatment-effect range and uncertainty by weather condition.
garden_cooling.limitations: The experiment concerns irrigated turf in Burnley. It does not directly estimate trees, garden beds, potted plants or all Melbourne properties. The dataset must not be trained on until its record-level licence is confirmed.
